subject.title: fix(models): clear stale auth cooldowns after early limit resets

question: Should OpenClaw standardize early provider-limit recovery as an explicit `models auth clear-cooldown` operator command, rather than automatic provider probing or a shorter persisted cooldown policy?
rationale: The branch safely implements one requested workaround, but the linked report also proposes automatic probing and different cooldown semantics; selecting the permanent user-recovery contract is product and provider-policy direction.

options.title: Adopt explicit CLI recovery
options.body: Accept the profile-scoped clear command as the supported initial recovery surface, contingent on inspectable live proof of inherited-store clearing and safe restart behavior.

options.title: Design automatic recovery first
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers decide whether provider health probing or a revised cooldown policy should replace manual operator recovery.

options.title: Narrow the command contract
options.body: Keep a manual recovery command but define a smaller supported state set or a clearer gateway refresh mechanism before merge.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit CLI recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the profile-scoped clear command as the supported initial recovery surface, contingent on inspectable live proof of inherited-store clearing and safe restart behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked report supplies the concrete user-recovery requirements and tradeoffs that need maintainer sponsorship.
